title: Four folding doors in the opening

options.name: The design
options.text: Four pine folding doors in two pairs, hung from a track under the head of a new timber lining. Each pair folds back to its own side, so the whole opening clears. Architrave goes round both sides of the opening.

poster.alt: 3D model of four pine folding doors in two pairs filling a wide opening between two rooms

notes: The opening width, height and wall thickness are measured.
The lining, the gaps round the doors, the door sizes and the architrave are standard sizes to start from.
The skirting and picture rail are made good on both sides of the wall where they meet the new opening.
Colours on screen are a guide.
